name: The personal X account of Nano Labs founder Jack Kong
classificationNote: Classified by TypeSafe jev-1.13.0 (confidence 0.86). Replaced keyword guess "access-control".
rootCause: The personal X account of Nano Labs founder Jack Kong was compromised. Attackers used it to promote a fake AI trading token called Binance World Assets ($BWA), claiming it would use trading fees on BNB Chain to trade bStocks and share profits with holders. Nano Labs’ official account later stated that the posts were unauthorized, that the company had not issued or endorsed any such token, and warned users not to click links or send funds to any contracts.
